integrity: The complex is reconstructed from the published A4 permutation generators and three facet orbits. Integral first homology is proved by unimodular reduction; exact free and torsion coordinates are independently checked by cocycles; all graph triangles and the published symmetry action are exhaustively enumerated.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the labeled vertex-transitive twelve-vertex nonorientable genus-four triangulation and simplicial edge length. The displayed splitting of first homology is explicit but noncanonical; longer cycles and other triangulations are not classified.
title: Both torsion lifts occur in every triangular systolic direction of the twelve-vertex nonorientable genus-four surface
